D: A teenager moves to Santa Carla and falls in with a gang of teenage vampires.
P: Serve the noodles when David makes Michael see his rice as maggots.
S: Thin fries tossed with garlic powder, parsley and salt, served in paper cones
Thin fries soaked, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C, tossed with garlic salt and parsley, in paper cones.
Frog brothers' roast garlic bean dip
the vampire hunters stock up on garlic

Silky cannellini dip loaded with a whole head of roasted garlic, lemon and olive oil, topped with chilli oil and parsley, with toasted pita chips. Wrap 1 whole garlic bulb in foil and roast at 200C for 40 minutes. Cut 3 pita breads into wedges, brush with olive oil and bake for 8 minutes until crisp. Squeeze the soft garlic into a food processor with 2 drained 400g tins cannellini beans, the juice of 1 lemon, 60ml olive oil and salt, then blitz until smooth with a splash of water. Spread in a bowl and top with 1 tbsp chilli oil and chopped parsley.
Garlic baguette baked in foil. Get yourself a garlic T-shirt, buddy.
Baguette split, spread with butter mashed with lots of garlic, parsley and salt, wrapped in foil and baked at 200C for 12 minutes, then opened for 3.
M: Wok chicken and egg noodles in oyster sauce, with egg fried rice on the side
Lo mein: fresh egg noodles wok-tossed with chicken, cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts, oyster sauce, soy and sesame. Fried rice alongside.
Nobody touches the second shelf but Grandpa.

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky brown sugar tomato glaze, sliced thick over buttery mashed potato with minted peas and gravy. Mix 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt. Press into a loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and spread over the top. Bake at 180C for 60 minutes and rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk. Cook 400g frozen peas with mint and butter. Slice the meatloaf over the mash with peas and gravy.
W: Popcorn coated in brown sugar and golden syrup caramel, baked crisp
Popcorn tossed in brown sugar caramel with a pinch of bicarb, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15.
K: Holy water cucumber and lime fizz
Cucumber, lime and mint topped with soda water in small bottles, no alcohol

Crushed cucumber, lime and mint shaken with a little sugar syrup and topped with soda water, served in small glass bottles with a cross on the label. Muddle half a Lebanese cucumber, chopped, with the juice of 3 limes, a handful of mint and 60ml sugar syrup in a jug. Strain into 4 small glass bottles or tall glasses filled with ice. Top each with 150ml chilled soda water and a thin cucumber ribbon. Draw a little cross on paper tags and tie them round the necks.

dishes.make_ahead: Fries can be soaked up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries. Soak in cold water, then drain and dry very well.
Fry in batches in oil at 140C for about 5 minutes until pale and soft, then rest on a rack.
Reheat the oil to 190C and fry again until golden and crisp.
Toss with salt, garlic powder and parsley and serve in paper cones.

dishes.make_ahead: Mash the garlic butter and spread and wrap the baguette up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; bake on the night

steps.text: Mash the butter with the garlic, parsley and salt.
Split the baguette and spread generously, then wrap in foil.
Bake at 200C, then open the foil and bake again to crisp the top.

dishes.make_ahead: Slice the chicken and shred the cabbage up to 1 day ahead, chilled; stir-fry on the night

steps.text: Slice the chicken, shred the cabbage and slice the spring onions.
Stir-fry the chicken in a smoking wok until browned.
Add the cabbage, bean sprouts and noodles and toss with the oyster sauce, soy and sesame oil.
Scramble the eggs in a second pan, add the rice and spring onion and fry until hot, then serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Press and slice the tofu and shred the cabbage up to 1 day ahead, chilled; stir-fry on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and slice, shred the cabbage and slice the spring onions.
Stir-fry the tofu in a smoking wok with most of the vegetable oil until browned.
Add the cabbage, bean sprouts and noodles and toss with the mushroom oyster sauce, soy and sesame oil.
Scramble the eggs in a second pan with the rest of the oil, add the rice and spring onion and fry until hot, then serve alongside.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 3 days in an airtight tin

steps.text: Pop the kernels in a covered pot and tip into a large bowl.
Boil the sugar, butter and golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in the bicarb.
Pour over the popcorn, toss and bake at 120C, stirring every 15 minutes.
Cool on the tray and break up.

dishes.make_ahead: Muddle the cucumber, lime and mint with the syrup and strain up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; add soda water and ice just before serving

steps.text: Chop half the cucumber and muddle with the lime juice, mint and syrup in a jug.
Strain into small glass bottles or tall glasses filled with ice.
Top with chilled soda water and a thin cucumber ribbon. Tie paper cross tags round the necks.

s.note: Thin fries tossed with garlic powder, parsley and salt, served in paper cones
s.how: Cut 1kg russets into thin fries, soak for 30 minutes and dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 190C until golden. Toss with fine salt, garlic powder and chopped parsley and serve in paper cones.

s.note: Garlic baguette baked in foil. Get yourself a garlic T-shirt, buddy.
s.how: Mash 100g soft butter with 4 crushed garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt. Split a baguette, spread generously, wrap in foil and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Open the foil and bake 3 minutes more to crisp.

m.note: Wok chicken and egg noodles in oyster sauce, with egg fried rice on the side
m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs in a smoking wok, then add a quarter cabbage, 200g bean sprouts and 400g fresh egg noodles. Toss with 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy and sesame oil. Fry 300g cooked jasmine rice with egg and spring onion alongside.

w.note: Popcorn coated in brown sugar and golden syrup caramel, baked crisp
w.how: Pop 120g kernels. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 3 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a tsp bicarb. Pour over the popcorn, toss and bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Cool and break up.

Top each with 150ml chilled soda water and a thin cucumber ribbon. Draw a little cross on paper tags and tie them round the necks.
